```{python}
#| label: setup
import altair as alt
import pandas as pd

penguins = pd.read_csv("penguins.csv").dropna()
species_colors = alt.Scale(
    domain=["Adelie", "Chinstrap", "Gentoo"],
    range=["#ff8c00", "#a034f0", "#159090"],
)
```

## Column {width=25%}

```{python}
#| component: valuebox
#| title: "Penguins measured"
#| icon: database
#| color: primary
dict(value=f"{len(penguins):,}")
```

```{python}
#| component: valuebox
#| title: "Avg body mass (g)"
#| icon: speedometer2
#| color: info
dict(value=f"{penguins.body_mass_g.mean():,.0f}")
```

```{python}
#| component: valuebox
#| title: "Islands"
#| icon: geo-alt
#| color: success
dict(value=penguins.island.nunique())
```

## Column {width=75%}

### Row {height=60%}

```{python}
#| title: Bill length vs. depth
alt.Chart(penguins).mark_point(filled=True, opacity=0.7).encode(
    x=alt.X("bill_length_mm:Q", scale=alt.Scale(zero=False), title="Bill length (mm)"),
    y=alt.Y("bill_depth_mm:Q", scale=alt.Scale(zero=False), title="Bill depth (mm)"),
    color=alt.Color("species:N", scale=species_colors),
    tooltip=["species", "island", "sex", "body_mass_g"],
).properties(width="container", height="container").interactive()
```

### Row {height=40%}

::: {.card title="Species by island"}
```{python}
alt.Chart(penguins).mark_bar().encode(
    y=alt.Y("island:N", title=None),
    x=alt.X("count()", title="Penguins"),
    color=alt.Color("species:N", scale=species_colors),
).properties(width="container", height="container")
```
:::

::: {.card title="Body mass distribution"}
```{python}
alt.Chart(penguins).mark_bar(opacity=0.8).encode(
    x=alt.X("body_mass_g:Q", bin=alt.Bin(maxbins=25), title="Body mass (g)"),
    y=alt.Y("count()", title=None),
    color=alt.Color("species:N", scale=species_colors),
).properties(width="container", height="container")
```
:::
